title: Nori opens orders for a $1,688 two-armed home robot
friendlyTitle: A lower-cost home robot is now taking orders
summary: Nori Robotics is taking full-price orders for the Nori A3, a mobile two-armed robot scheduled to ship in fall 2026. The company lists a 1.5-kilogram payload per arm, four cameras, lidar, voice input, six-to-eight-hour battery life and a laptop app for training and control.
friendlySummary: The Nori A3 has two arms, cameras, voice control and wheels. It costs $1,688 and the company says it will ship later in 2026.
whyItMatters: A comparatively low entry price could broaden hands-on development of embodied AI and household automation. It remains a preorder with company-stated capabilities, so buyers should weigh delivery, support, safety and the gap between demonstration tasks and reliable daily use.
friendlyWhyItMatters: More people may be able to experiment with useful home robots. It is still a preorder, so buyers should be careful about delivery promises and real-world reliability.
